statements.t: We remain on track to report topline results from our Phase 3 NOVA-2 trial of LB-102 in schizophrenia in the first half of 2027.
With a strong balance sheet and cash runway expected to extend beyond the second quarter of 2029, we believe we are exceptionally well positioned to maximize the broader potential of LB-102.”
